perks.basis: Read from the text of their own open postings written in English; postings in other languages are not read yet. A tick means at least {{strongPct}}% of the postings we could read in that country state it; a dot means at least {{minK}} of at least {{minN}} postings, and at least {{minPct}}%, do. We list only perks whose reading we have checked. "At least" because our reader can miss a mention.
